name: io.github.AIWerk/mcp-server-imap
description: Email tools for any IMAP/SMTP provider: list, read, search, send, and manage messages.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_PASS
environmentVariables.description: IMAP account password or app-specific password.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SMTP server hostname, required to send email.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_USER
environmentVariables.description: SMTP account username (defaults to IMAP_USER if unset).

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PASS
environmentVariables.description: SMTP account password (defaults to IMAP_PASS if unset).
